source: Top level: the 12 consensus topics of the flat k = 12 BERTopic runs (eval/topics/runs/stability_k12). Subtopics: the 32 HDBSCAN subtopics (eval/topics/runs/hier_qa_mc10_p10_dd95), each under the k = 12 topic holding most of its pairs, plus an animal fluency subtopic, which the HDBSCAN run did not form.
rule: Pick the label for what the question asks the caregiver to understand or do, using the answer to settle it. Give a secondary label only when the pair clearly covers a second topic as well.

topics.name: Daily routines, memory and independence
topics.definition: Helping the person through the day: routines and schedules, memory and cue support, feeling safe and secure, keeping independence, meaningful everyday activities, mobility, and adapting to the person's GEMS state.

topics.name: Programs, care coordination and long-term care
topics.definition: The services and systems around care: care programs and training, community and dementia-friendly spaces, organizations and advocacy, long-term care facilities (including during COVID), first responders, and questions about the episode or its speakers.

topics.name: Caregiver self-care, transitions and medication
topics.definition: The caregiver's own stress, emotions, health and support; coping with transitions and change; keeping the person's dignity in the care relationship; decisions about medication.

topics.name: Communication: responding without correcting
topics.definition: How to talk with and respond to the person: words, tone, pace, not arguing or correcting, and handling agitation, anger or challenging behavior in the moment.

topics.name: Brain changes and behavior
topics.definition: Why the person behaves or perceives differently: the brain changes behind behavior, memory and perception, hallucinations and delusions, and dementia versus normal aging.

topics.name: Physical assistance and touch
topics.definition: Hands-on physical help: sitting, standing, transfers and positioning, the hand-under-hand technique, help with eating and drinking, and touch and sensory tolerance.

topics.name: Loneliness, social connection and celebrations
topics.definition: Isolation and loneliness, social interaction, involving family and friends, holidays and celebrations.

topics.name: FTD and primary progressive aphasia
topics.definition: Frontotemporal dementia and related conditions (ALS-FTD, primary progressive aphasia, corticobasal syndrome, PSP), the differences between dementia types, and which brain areas do what.

topics.name: Art, creativity and storytelling
topics.definition: Art and other creative activities, storytelling, reminiscence and sharing life stories.

topics.name: Down syndrome and dementia
topics.definition: Dementia in people with Down syndrome or other intellectual and developmental disabilities.

topics.name: Music and rhythm
topics.definition: Music, singing, rhythm and dance in dementia care.

topics.name: Memory screening: animal fluency test
topics.definition: Cognitive screening tests and memory baselines, especially the animal fluency test.

subtopics.name: Feeling safe and secure
subtopics.definition: Helping the person feel safe, calm, comfortable and secure in their surroundings.

subtopics.name: Visual and verbal cues
subtopics.definition: Using visual, verbal and environmental cues so the person understands and can act.

subtopics.name: Meaningful activities
subtopics.definition: Everyday activities that keep the person engaged, active and feeling useful.

subtopics.name: Schedules and routines
subtopics.definition: Daily schedules, routines, appointments and structure.

subtopics.name: GEMS stages
subtopics.definition: Teepa Snow's GEMS states (Sapphire, Diamond, Emerald, Amber, Ruby, Pearl) and what each means for care.

subtopics.name: Mobility and walking
subtopics.definition: Walking, movement and keeping mobility as abilities change.

subtopics.name: Lessons from the episode
subtopics.definition: Questions about the video itself, its speakers or their stories, or the Positive Approach to Care program, rather than about care.

subtopics.name: Community and dementia-friendly spaces
subtopics.definition: Community involvement, dementia-friendly places, reducing stigma and raising awareness.

subtopics.name: COVID in long-term care
subtopics.definition: Care facilities and residents, especially during the COVID-19 pandemic.

subtopics.name: Organizations and advocacy roles
subtopics.definition: Organizations, professional roles, support groups, advocacy and care coordination.

subtopics.name: First responders
subtopics.definition: Police, paramedics and other first responders meeting people living with dementia, and their training.

subtopics.name: Caregiver emotional coping
subtopics.definition: The caregiver's stress, grief, guilt and emotions, and how to cope with them.

subtopics.name: Caregiver self-care
subtopics.definition: The caregiver's own health, rest, breaks and support.

subtopics.name: Dignity: feeling valued and respected
subtopics.definition: Treating the person with respect so they feel valued and keep their identity.

subtopics.name: Transitions
subtopics.definition: Coping with change and transitions: moves, new routines, new stages of life.

subtopics.name: Communication techniques
subtopics.definition: How to speak, listen and respond so communication works: words, tone, pace, not correcting.

subtopics.name: Agitation and challenging behavior
subtopics.definition: Responding to agitation, anger, anxiety, refusal and other distressed behavior.

subtopics.name: Brain changes and behavior
subtopics.definition: How brain changes explain behavior, memory, perception and decisions; dementia versus normal aging.

subtopics.name: Hallucinations and delusions
subtopics.definition: Hallucinations, delusions and false beliefs, and how to respond.

subtopics.name: Sitting and standing
subtopics.definition: Helping the person sit, stand, transfer and position their body safely.

subtopics.name: Touch and sensory changes
subtopics.definition: Touch, sensory sensitivity and how to approach physically.

subtopics.name: Eating and drinking
subtopics.definition: Meals, eating, drinking and help at mealtimes.

subtopics.name: Hand-under-hand technique
subtopics.definition: Teepa Snow's hand-under-hand technique for guiding and supporting.

subtopics.name: Loneliness and social connection
subtopics.definition: Loneliness, isolation and staying connected to other people.

subtopics.name: Holidays and family events
subtopics.definition: Holidays, celebrations, visits and family gatherings.

subtopics.name: Dementia types: FTD, ALS, CBS
subtopics.definition: Frontotemporal dementia, ALS-FTD, corticobasal syndrome, PSP and how dementia types differ.

subtopics.name: Brain anatomy
subtopics.definition: Which parts of the brain do what (prefrontal cortex, amygdala, limbic system and so on).

subtopics.name: Primary progressive aphasia
subtopics.definition: Primary progressive aphasia, its variants and the language changes it causes.

subtopics.name: Art
subtopics.definition: Painting, drawing and other art and creative activities.

subtopics.name: Storytelling and reminiscence
subtopics.definition: Storytelling, reminiscence and sharing life stories.

subtopics.name: Down syndrome and dementia
subtopics.definition: Dementia in people with Down syndrome or other intellectual and developmental disabilities.

subtopics.name: Music
subtopics.definition: Music, singing, rhythm and dance.

subtopics.name: Animal fluency test
subtopics.definition: The animal fluency test and other memory screening or baseline tests.
